THIS ZONE FILE POINTS AT FOOTAGE THAT IS NOT COMMITTED. testdata/youtube/sTF-6_xinUU.mp4 is deliberately gitignored: it is video pulled off somebody else's site and nobody has been asked, so it is not republished here.
It is kept because the line was MEASURED against that footage — the line is inside the band the detector actually saw the traffic occupy, which is why it works. A line measured against material you no longer have is worse than no line at all.
The committed demo runs testdata/car-crossing.mp4 with testdata/car-crossing.zones.json, and both of those ARE in git.
The zone for the traffic-camera footage, drawn from the frames rather than guessed.
The cars cross the LOWER third of the frame, left to right, at about y=0.72 of the
height. The line runs horizontally across the carriageway just above them, so a car
crossing it is a car that has entered the junction.
Measured, not assumed: detections at t=53s land at x1=0.37 y1=0.69 x2=0.91 y2=1.00, and at
t=81s at x1=0.01 y1=0.23 x2=0.47 y2=0.71. The line is placed on the near carriageway.
provenance: real. The footage is a public traffic camera. Every number the report
derives from it is labelled real, and the false-positive rate is still NOT RUN until a
person marks which of the model's 'cars' are really traffic lights.
note: Drawn from the measured detections. A wrong line produces zero events and no error, so this is verified by a run that is expected to produce one.
